Why did France get so much of Africa? (Short Animated Documentary)
all_videos.description:
As many of you will know, when Africa was Scrambled by the European powers (and Belgium) in the late 19th century, France got a massive chunk of it all to itself. But given that France was seen as the great enemy of Europe and went through long periods of imposed Isolationism, why did it get so much? Why did France get so much of Africa and why didn't the other great powers do anything about it? To find out watch this short and simple animated history documentary.

all_videos.title: Why didn't Castro try to retake Guantanamo Bay from America?
all_videos.description:
Throughout the Cold War, US-Cuban relations weren't exactly great. Castro, Cuba's leader, never acknowledged the US' ownership of the Naval Base at Guantanamo Bay as legitimate but during the decades after he took power he never made a single concerted effort to get it back. So why not? To find out watch this short and simple animated history documentary.

How close was the US to another Civil War in 1876? (Short Animated Documentary)
all_videos.description:
The 1876 election was a hotly contested one with results from numerous states contested with both candidates claiming victory. During the 4 months leading up to the inauguration tensions grew massively and many people across the Unites States feared the breakdown of the government and the beginning a second Civil War in 1876/1877. But how realistic were these fears? Was the USA actually close to another civil war in after the 1876 election? To find out watch this short and simple animated history documentary.

Why didn't Saddam Hussein back down before the Gulf War? (Animated History Documentary)
all_videos.description:
In the lead up to the Gulf War, Iraq and its leader Saddam Hussein had five months to back down and avoid an armed conflict altogether. This never happened and as you'll likely know Iraq was swiftly crushed by a US-led coalition in 1991. But given how Saddam never really stood a chance, why didn't he try to back down and avoid war? To find out watch this short and simple animated history documentary.

Why didn't Buchanan do more to stop the Civil War? (Short Animated Documentary)
Why did Emperor Napoleon depose his brother? (Short Animated History)
Why did Mexico choose an Austrian to be its Emperor? (Short Animated Documentary)
Why did Europe obey the Monroe Doctrine? (Short Animated Documentary)
all_videos.description:
When President James Monroe declared in 1823 that Europeans were no longer allowed to crush revolting colonies or expand further into the Americas, the US wasn't exactly powerful enough to enforce it. In spite of this, European attempts to colonise the region reduced massively and many kept to the Monroe doctrine's demands. But given that they didn't have to why did they and what did the US do when some Europeans broke it? To find out watch this short and simple animated history documentary.

all_videos.description:
When Charlemagne founded the Holy Roman Empire, it included the vast majority of what's now France. In the centuries that followed, the Holy Roman Empire had moved away from these lands into central Europe. So why did this happen? Why did France, named for the Franks, separate from the territories ruled by Charlemagne's imperial successors? To find out watch this short and simple animated history documentary.

all_videos.description:
